description: The middle fk control is at (4,0,0) and turns 40 degrees about Z, so the last one, 4 along its X, is at (4 + 4 cos 40, 4 sin 40, 0) = (7.064178, 2.571150, 0). The end ik control and the last joint float there, the end turned 40 with it. The middle ik control and joint stay at (4,0,0), where the curve passes through the middle fk control.
